q.instruction: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
q.passage:
Presented ­here in part II is the second group of two cue categories, the “bodily cue categories.

(A) But cues of the corporal category consist simply of the location of the speaker’s or hearer’s ­whole body. Both the bodily cue categories are more elaborate where the target is speech-­external. Accordingly, analy­sis of their use for speech-­external targets begins and occupies most of the next two chapters, while analy­sis of their use for speech-­internal targets follows more briefly.

(B) But each category represents a more specific source of information. Cues of the gestural category consist of movements or configurations of parts of the speaker’s body produced volitionally.

(C) ” This group consists of the category of gestural cues and the category of corporal cues, treated respectively in the next two chapters. As the general source of information common to both ­these categories, the body of one of the speech participants provides the cues to the target.
q.explanation:
원문 전개 순서는 (C) - (B) - (A)이다. 각 단락의 지시어·연결어가 앞 내용을 받아 이 순서로만 논리가 이어진다.
